card.name: Fluid and supportive care wording
card.fires_on: The word "fluid" (or a nearby linking word) in lists of supportive care, such as fluid therapy, fluid balance, and fluid and electrolyte balance. It also fires on small words like "with" or "and" just before supplements or fluids.

modes.label: The word fluid in care lists
modes.description: "fluid" appears as the first word of a phrase like fluid therapy or fluid balance in overdose or supportive-care text.
modes.example: Monitoring of vital signs and<< fluid>> balance.

modes.label: Linking word before supplies
modes.description: "with" or "and" falls just before food, vitamin or other supplements in animal care text.
modes.example: All anurans should be supplied<< with>> food and vitamin supplements.

card.plain: It marks the spot where fluids or supportive care come up in treatment text, especially the word "fluid" before therapy or balance.
